requirement: Every pre-packaged commodity must declare its common or generic name.
source: Department of Consumer Affairs / LMPC Rules

requirement: Every package must declare the name and address of the manufacturer, packer or importer, as applicable.
source: Department of Consumer Affairs / LMPC Rules

requirement: Country of origin must be declared for imported products.
source: Department of Consumer Affairs / LMPC Rules

requirement: The package must declare net quantity in the standard unit of weight, measure or number.
source: Department of Consumer Affairs / LMPC Rules

requirement: The package must declare the month and year of manufacture or packing.
source: Department of Consumer Affairs / LMPC Rules

requirement: Best before or use by information is required for commodities that may become unfit for human consumption.
applicable_to: food or other commodities with a consumption fitness period
source: Department of Consumer Affairs / LMPC Rules

requirement: The package must declare the retail sale price in the form of Maximum Retail Price (MRP), inclusive of taxes.
applicable_to: pre-packaged commodities offered for retail sale
source: Department of Consumer Affairs / LMPC Rules

requirement: The package must provide consumer care details sufficient to contact the responsible entity.
source: Department of Consumer Affairs / LMPC Rules

requirement: Unit sale price is checked where the applicable packaged-commodity requirement is established by the product and current amendment context.
applicable_to: where applicable under current LMPC requirements and amendments
source: Department of Consumer Affairs / LMPC Rules
